description: Energie - Réseau de chauffage urbain - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Poitiers Open Data. The heating network of the City of Poitiers supplies heat (heating) and domestic hot water 7500 housing equivalents on the Coronaries and Saint Eloi, from an energy mix composed of the 3 different heat sources (UVE, Biomass, gas). Coverage: Grand Poitiers Open Data. The portal shows the English title as "Energy - District heating network - Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Poitiers Open Data. Its keywords include chauffage-urbain, chaleur, usine-de-valorisation-energetique, chauffage, reseau-de-chauffage, biomasse. The listing shows 4 download or service links in URL, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
